observations.conclusion: expanded = measuredOverflow || forcedExpanded. Focus and nonempty short text do not independently expand this branch.

Inline ordinal2 also reaches measuredOverflow || forcedExpanded. Its selection is restricted to ldo selector with v45; null selector remains Default. No evidence supports mapping all Chat to Inline or globally suppressing overflow.

mdo, ldo and ndo slots each have conditions. Null is a valid result. v624 host unconditional modelLabel for Chat and Work was an independent synthetic fixture choice, and supplied the exact condition that expands focused or nonempty Chat.

Overflow checks measured width and height, with height threshold1.1 times single line. Empty Enter/newline can set forcedExpanded via m0e0.b/w4o. This is text editing behavior distinct from availability of model controls.
